title: Duo acceptance: live workspace to collisions
intro: Everything built since the live workspace (Phase E) through organising, Send to Claude, local HTML with the element picker, duo2 parity, Claude editing open documents, and collisions with changes on disk. Open Duo on the fixture workspace first: run `scripts/acceptance/open-duo.sh` in the duo-v2 repo. Fixtures live in ~/DuoAcceptance (rebuild with `scripts/acceptance/fixtures.py --reset`). Each test has a Set up test button (Duo arranges the fixtures) and, where Claude ran it first, what Claude did and what still needs your judgment.
setup: In a terminal: `cd ~/repos/duo-v2 && scripts/acceptance/open-duo.sh` (it adds any new fixtures without resetting yours)
duo2 commands: use `~/repos/duo-v2/build/Duo.app/Contents/Helpers/duo2` from a normal terminal, or plain `duo2` inside a Duo session's terminal (or anywhere, once you accept the install question).
Several Send items need a Claude session showing: open checkout and click `+ New session` first.
